list.name: Reef Sprat
list.note: Lots of them. All one idea. If you go left they all go left.
list.hint: Small fish, in crowds, on the reef.

list.name: Blue Wrasse
list.note: Very busy. Looks like it's late for something.
list.hint: Busy blue fish over the coral.

list.name: Banded Snapper
list.note: Does not like to be looked at. I looked at it.

list.name: Green Turtle
list.note: Rows with its front arms. Doesn't care about you.

list.name: Manta Ray
list.note: Flies. In water. Nobody said it could.

list.name: Reef Shark
list.note: Rude. Smaller than it thinks.

list.name: Blue Shark
list.note: Gran says leave them alone. They should be told the same.

list.name: Dolphin
list.note: Laughing at something. Probably me.
list.hint: In a pod at the surface.

list.name: Whale
list.note: Too big for the page. I had to use two pages. Sings the same bit if you listen.

list.name: Moon Jelly
list.note: No bones, no brain, no problems.
list.hint: In the deep dark, lit up.

list.name: Reaver
list.note: Not a fish. Gran says don't write them down. I'm writing them down.

list.name: Sea Otter
list.note: They hold hands asleep so nobody floats away. Bram says I can't have one.
list.hint: At the top of the kelp.

list.name: Grey Seal
list.note: Fat. Happy. Would like your fish.

list.name: Narwhal
list.note: A whale with a spear. I want one. I want to be one.

list.name: Anglerfish
list.note: Don't follow the small light. I'm told.

list.name: Moray Eel
list.note: Lives in a hole. Comes out angry.

list.name: Hammerhead
list.note: Whoever made this was in a hurry.

list.name: Giant Crab
list.note: Bigger than our table. Would not be good at our table.

list.name: Herring Gull
list.note: Stole my lunch. Not in the sea but it goes in the book.

list.name: Goat
list.note: Bishop. Not a sea creature. He'd like you to think he is.

list.name: Hill Deer
list.note: Only comes down when the bell rings. Used to not come at all.

list.name: Shore Crab
list.note: Sideways. I tried it. It's harder than it looks.

list.name: Flying Fish
list.note: It's a fish. It flies. The whole sea is showing off.

list.name: Swordfish
list.note: Like a narwhal that went to fencing school.

list.name: Reaver Captain
list.note: Still giving orders. Somebody should tell him the war's over. Nobody's offered.
list.hint: Where Reavers stand in a line.

list.name: Reaver Archer
list.note: Throws a harpoon a long way. Gran says move.

list.name: Siren
list.note: It sings. I put wax in my ears. It did nothing. I was under water.
list.hint: Deep, and only if you listen.

list.name: Frost Wight
list.note: Cold enough to make the water creak. Tove says they were sailors once. She doesn't say whose.

list.name: Magma Husk
list.note: A shell of slag with something still walking about inside. Marta calls it the bad batch.

list.name: Duelist
list.note: Bows first. Then it's all a bit quick.

list.name: Thornback
list.note: Don't pet it. I'm writing this one-handed.
list.hint: On the bottom, looking like a rock.

list.name: The Leviathan
list.note: I didn't see this one. He told me. I drew it from what he said. It took all the pages.
